targetText: It was not, however, their specific national qualities which rejuvenated Europe, but simply ; their barbarism, their gentile constitution.
summary: The Germanic tribes breathed new vitality into post-Roman Europe not because of innate national traits, but because they retained democratic clan structures and communal traditions.
context: Engels debunks nationalistic myths surrounding the fall of Rome. The vitality of Germanic society stemmed from its surviving tribal clan solidarity, which laid the basis for medieval peasant mark communities.
